I'm holder X (influence tie: I have 1, others 1, tie_order [1,2,0], so I'm holder). I should produce goods to sell in later markets, but shuttle gives 3 goods with 25% seizure risk? Shuttle gives grey goods. Round 3 action, markets remain rounds 4,5,6. I need influence? Element 0 has influence 2, holder is me by tie_order. In law phase, holder is max influence at law entry — element 0 has 2 influence, so I'd lose holder next law unless I bribe. Bribing gives influence but costs cash. Influence 2 (5 alashi bribe) ties element 0, tie_order favors me (1 vs 0). Then I hold veto power.

But this round action matters for goods. Options: bribe 5 + no goods... but can't both. Bid auction is round 4.

Trade-off: shuttle gives 3 goods (25% seizure risk? tariff — black tariff protects; currently no tariff). Produce gives 2 goods free safely. Shuttle expected ~2.25 goods. Value per good at next market price ~7-8 alashi minus devaluation (cash devalues 38% each round start: floor(cash/100)*62 — actually devaluation keeps only 62%). Goods don't devalue! So goods are valuable vs cash. Cash devalues heavily each round. So maximize goods, sell late? Selling late gives promissory risk... sell gives cash which devalues.

Cash devaluation: cash → 62%. So cash should be spent or converted to goods. Sell only in final round (round 6). So accumulate goods now, sell round 6.

So shuttle (3 goods, ~25% seizure) vs produce (2). Expected shuttle = 2.25 goods > 2. Take shuttle, choice 3.
